description: Determines refund eligibility based on objective policy rules extracted from the message content, ignoring emotional appeals or customer demands.

problems.prompt:
Based on the customer message, classify refund eligibility using standard e-commerce policy rules. If the message lacks required facts (e.g., purchase date, item condition), classify as needs_review.

Categories:
- eligible_full: Within return window, item unused or defective, proof of purchase mentioned or implied.
- eligible_partial: Item used or opened, partial damage, or outside standard window but within grace period.
- ineligible: Outside all return windows, non-returnable category (e.g., digital goods, final sale), or excessive wear.
- needs_review: Missing critical information (date, condition, category) to apply rules objectively.

Message: {message}

Output only the exact eligibility label.

args: I bought this sweater 5 days ago and it arrived with a hole in the sleeve. I have the receipt and the tags are still attached. Order #12345.
This phone charger I ordered 8 days ago doesn't work at all. It's still sealed in the original packaging and I can send you the invoice.
I opened the laptop box and used the laptop for two days but decided I want a different model. I bought it 12 days ago and have the receipt.
I received this jacket 40 days ago and only wore it once. It's in perfect condition. I know the 30-day window passed but I hope I can still return it.
I bought these running shoes 120 days ago and the soles are completely worn out. I want my money back.
I downloaded this software yesterday and realized I don't need it. Please refund me.
This dress was marked final sale when I purchased it 45 days ago. I removed the tags and wore it to a wedding. It has a wine stain.
The headphones I received are completely broken and won't turn on. I have the order number but need this refunded.
I bought this coffee maker 10 days ago. I want to return it.
I demand a refund immediately. This is the worst experience ever and you must make this right!
